summary: Frontend refactor verification: monolithic App.js was split into modular /pages/ components. Tested all routes, navigation, login flow, and protected route redirects using Playwright against the public preview URL. All 10 tested routes render correctly with no console/page errors. Login with verifytest@example.com/testpassword123 succeeds and lands on Dashboard. Protected routes (/scan, /my-scans, /analytics) redirect unauthenticated users to /login and load correctly when authenticated.
critical_code_review_comments: App.js now clean at 93 lines - good modular split into /pages/{auth,dashboard,pricing,scanner}
ProtectedRoute wrapper correctly redirects unauthenticated users to /login

Note: problem statement referenced credentials test@auditly.com/password123 which do NOT exist per /app/memory/test_credentials.md. Used verifytest@example.com/testpassword123 instead - main agent should update the request template if needed.
